{{Quote|Jekiah. I owe you an apology. At the first whisper of betrayal, you said to rein in the clans. I should have listened. But I'll cut you a deal. You don't say 'I told you so,' and I won't either. We needed someone suited to all the practical nonsense of leadership. I told you that wasn't me. If Heta continues, we lose everything. All of us. The Republic and the Sith will destroy the Mando'ade, no matter whose banner they carry. Shielding us from an outside threat&mdash;ensuring our future&mdash;is something I can do. It's what I will do. I need to stop Heta, and there's only one person who can tell me how to find her. The reason that Sith besbe'trayc ended up in her hands. Ni ceta, Jekiah. I hope you understand.|Shae Vizla's message to Jekiah Ordo|<ref name="sundering" />}}
'''Malgus's escape'''<ref name="MalgusEscape">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Malgus' Escape}}</ref> was an event that took place around [[3623 BBY]] in which [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] and her [[Mandalore the Avenger's crew|mercenaries]] undertook a mission to [[Carrick Station]]. Fearing that the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|war]] that [[Heta Kol]] [[Attack on the Spirit of Vengeance II|started]] would draw the ire of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], who could step in and destroy all [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] regardless of their affiliation, Vizla rescinded her [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|title]] and decided to align herself with the one person that knows how to find Heta Kol and put a stop to her: [[Darth Malgus]], breaking the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] out of Carrick Station and escaping.<ref name="sundering" />

==Behind the scenes==
For Imperial classes, Shae Vizla heads to [[Vaiken Spacedock]] instead. Aside from differences in droid models present, the battle remains the same.<ref name="sundering" />
